headline: Strong Execution Coupled with Healthy Operating Leverage

highlights: Actual for Q2FY27: Revenue - INLINE; EBITDA (Adj.) - MISS; PAT - MISS Changes in Estimates Post Q2FY27 FY27E/FY28E: Revenue: 0%/0%; EBITDA (Adj.): 0%/0%; PAT: 0%/0% Recommendation Rationale • Strong Revenue Growth and Operating Leverage: LG Electronics delivered a strong Q2FY27 performance, with revenue growing 19.5% YoY to Rs 7,380 Cr, driven by broad-based double-digit growth across all key product categories.
EBITDA increased 28% YoY to Rs 701 Cr, while EBITDA margin expanded 63 bps to 9.5%.
Despite elevated commodity prices, forex headwinds and higher go-to-market investments, the company demonstrated strong operating leverage through volume growth and premiumization.

Its ability to protect margins through selective pricing, cost efficiencies and a richer product mix reflects the strength of its operating model. • Premiumisation and Expanding Exports Provide a Long Growth Runway: The company is well positioned to benefit from rising disposable incomes, low household appliance penetration and increasing consumer preference for premium products.

The LG Essential Series is also gaining traction by targeting first-time buyers and affordability-conscious consumers while contributing positively to profitability.

The combination of premiumization, first-time household penetration and export expansion provides multiple avenues for sustained revenue growth. • Sri City Expansion and B2B Diversification: The Rs 5,000 Cr Sri City manufacturing facility is expected to double existing production capacity and strengthen localisation, cost competitiveness and export capabilities.
